name: Komagome
tagline: Shinjuku in 20 minutes and Tokyo in 21 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000.
summary: The station is in Toshima City, where JR East and Tokyo Metro run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 21 minutes to Otemachi, 20 minutes to Shinjuku, 25 minutes to Shibuya and 36 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. The station stands 22.8 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 13.4 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 22.8 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 11.2 m to 24.6 m, a difference of 13.4 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 5 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 32 clinics and 27 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 都立駒込病院, about 18 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 東京健生病院, about 28 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. JR Yamanote Line run through it. Tokyo Metro Namboku Line also call here. The lines are split between operators (JR East runs 1 line and Tokyo Metro runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Namboku Line runs at 156% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 駒込→本駒込, which includes this station. JR Yamanote Line runs at 136% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 新大久保→新宿, which this station is not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥100,000 to ¥110,000 and 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. 1LDK ¥170,000 to ¥180,000 and 2LDK ¥210,000 to ¥220,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the low side. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For how close the centre is, Sugamo; for lower rent, Komagome.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Komagome. Sugamo has the JR Yamanote Line and Toei Mita Line, a different set from Komagome. To Otemachi, for instance, Sugamo is 7 minutes quicker. A one-room flat costs about ¥6,000 more at Sugamo. On how little of the area is in the flood projection, Sugamo comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: For how close the centre is, Sengoku; for rail connections, Komagome.
neighbours.note: About 1 km from Komagome in a straight line. Sengoku has only the Toei Mita Line, so Komagome is the better connected. To Otemachi, for instance, Sengoku is 9 minutes quicker. A one-room flat also costs about ¥8,000 more at Sengoku. On how little of the area is in the flood projection, though, Sengoku comes out ahead.

goodFor: People who want to finish their shopping on foot
People who want a park close by
notFor: The data does not show a drawback particular to this station
noiseSources: 本郷通り (2 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 14 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 4 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the low side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are heavily loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: Whether a flat faces the road changes what you hear indoors.
